_meta._comment: Danger Ghost - Niteroi isometric overworld grid. Real-world street geometry sourced from OpenStreetMap (ODbL). Generated for the entrance-tower feature at Rua Beltrao leading into Episodio 1.
_meta.osm_attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, data available under the Open Database License (ODbL) - https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

real_world_reference.name_note: OSM has no way literally named 'Rua Beltrao'. The closest, verified real street is 'Rua Doutor Beltrao' (osm way ids 182630122 + 785117600), a residential street in the Santa Rosa neighbourhood of Niteroi-RJ. OSM's own data carries an editorial note on both ways ('Please confirm name: Rua vs Travessa') flagging uncertainty about whether it should be 'Rua' or 'Travessa'. A separate, different street named 'Travessa Beltrao' (way id 182630104) also exists about 250m to the northeast and was NOT used as the origin - do not confuse the two.
real_world_reference.origin_definition: Origin (0,0) is the true midpoint by distance (50% of cumulative length) along the combined Rua Doutor Beltrao polyline (ways 182630122 + 785117600), NOT a bounding-box centroid.

data_source.query_1_purpose: Fetch exact geometry of the 2 way-segments forming Rua Doutor Beltrao by OSM id (ids obtained from a prior Nominatim search: https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=Rua+Beltr%C3%A3o,+Niter%C3%B3i,+RJ,+Brasil&format=json), plus the neighbouring Travessa Beltrao for disambiguation.
data_source.query_2_purpose: Fetch every OSM way tagged highway=* within 600m of the computed origin point, used to rasterize the walkable street network.
data_source.extraction_note: Both queries were executed for real against the live Overpass API during this session; no coordinates in this file are invented.

projection.method: local equirectangular (flat-earth approximation), adequate at this scale (<1km)
projection.formula_y_south_meters: y = (origin_lat - lat) * meters_per_degree_latitude   // NOTE: y is SOUTH-positive, matching row-major grid order (row 0 = north)

grid.tile_size_rationale: 10m/tile chosen so a typical Brazilian residential street (7-10m carriageway+sidewalks) occupies about 1 tile width, keeping streets walkable as a single lane in the isometric grid without inflating the map. Matches classic tile-RPG scale conventions.
grid.query_radius_rationale: 600m radius around the origin gives a believable multi-block neighbourhood context (well within the 500m-1km range) while keeping the Overpass query and resulting grid small enough to be practical.
grid.grid_extent_note: The deliverable grid is the largest AXIS-ALIGNED SQUARE fully inscribed in the 600m query circle (half-extent 600/sqrt(2)=424.26m, rounded down to 420m = 42 tiles), so every cell in this file is backed by real queried OSM data - no cell was extrapolated beyond the query radius.
grid.row_order: row 0 = northernmost row; row increases southward
grid.col_order: col 0 = westernmost column; col increases eastward
grid.cell_to_local_meters: x_m = (col - half_extent_tiles) * tile_size_m ; y_m = (row - half_extent_tiles) * tile_size_m

legend.L: landmark (Rua Beltrao entrance tower to Episodio 1)

grid.encoding: grid.rows is an array of DIM strings, each DIM characters long, one character per cell per the legend above. rows[row][col].

classification_method.street: A cell is 'street' if its center lies within halfwidth_by_highway_type meters of some OSM way tagged highway=*, measured as point-to-segment distance on the projected polyline (halfwidths per tools/build-overworld-grid.js HALFWIDTH_M, ~1.3x the original pass), THEN a deterministic diagonal-gap-closing pass (closeDiagonalGaps) promotes the orthogonal bridge cell closer to a real way wherever two street cells only touched corner-to-corner - see the root-cause note at the top of tools/build-overworld-grid.js. Regenerated 2026-09-03T13:36:17.504Z after the Estagio 5 finding of 151 disconnected 4-connected components (only 19 walkable cells near the tower).
classification_method.block: Default classification for every cell not reached by a street buffer. This is a simplification: no separate OSM building-footprint query was run (block == 'not street'), since for a game-grid contract that is sufficient to make cells walkable/blocked; the art team can subdivide 'block' cells with building art freely without touching walkability.
classification_method.landmark: A fixed 3x3 tile footprint (30m x 30m) centered exactly on the grid origin (row 42, col 42), i.e. on Rua Doutor Beltrao's true midpoint. This overrides whatever street/block classification would otherwise apply there. The 3x3 size and centering are a PLACEHOLDER for the entrance-tower building footprint - level design/art should reposition or resize it (e.g. set back from the street centerline instead of straddling it) once the actual tower asset is authored.

connectivity_closing_pass.note: Diagonal-only-adjacent street cells (8-connected but not 4-connected, the only movement the game allows) get bridged by promoting whichever orthogonal neighbor cell is geometrically closest to a real OSM way. Runs to a fixed point (no more corner-only touches remain).

caveats: OSM coverage/accuracy in this exact neighbourhood was NOT field-verified by this pipeline; it is only as good as current OpenStreetMap volunteer mapping.
The 'block' classification does not distinguish real buildings from empty lots, plazas, or vegetation - it only means 'not within a mapped street's buffer'.
Diagonal/rasterized streets can appear jagged at 10m resolution; this is expected at this scale and can be smoothed at render time if desired.
Never re-host Google Maps/Earth imagery; this file contains no imagery, only derived OSM geometry, which is safe to redistribute under ODbL with attribution.

04/09/2026: torre (POI tower_rua_beltrao) reposicionada de novo, agora para row=48 col=31 (era row=40 col=40) a pedido do usuario - ver data/overworld/pois.json:_position_note para o raciocinio completo do lado do POI. Do lado deste arquivo de grid: as 9 celulas 'L' do footprint 3x3 ANTIGO (rows 39-41 x cols 39-41) foram revertidas para '#' (classificacao natural de quarteirao, igual as celulas vizinhas - nao havia como recuperar a classificacao 'pre-L' original sem reprocessar OSM, entao '#' foi escolhido por bater com a vizinhanca imediata), e as 9 celulas do footprint NOVO (rows 47-49 x cols 30-32) foram marcadas 'L'. Isto e necessario porque o laco de desenho em overworld.js pula qualquer celula '#' ANTES de checar se ela pertence ao footprint do POI (isInsidePoiFootprint) - um footprint sentado em cima de celulas '#' nao-marcadas nunca dispara drawTower(), mesmo com pois.json apontando pro lugar certo (bug encontrado ao vivo nesta sessao: a etiqueta flutuante 'Danger Ghost/Episodio 1' aparecia no lugar novo, mas o predio nao desenhava, porque so a etiqueta le poi._bounds diretamente - o predio depende do scan de celulas encontrar tipo 'tile' no footprint).

04/09/2026 (2a correcao, mesmo dia): a posicao row=48 col=31 acima era uma interpretacao APROXIMADA de screenshot (contorno vermelho desenhado a mao pelo usuario, comparado visualmente) - o usuario depois mandou a localizacao EXATA em texto: 'o local que deve ficar a torre e no comeco da rua beltrao com a rua mario viana'. Achado o no OSM real do cruzamento: o segmento osmId=785117600 ('Rua Doutor Beltrao') termina em (col=38.833,row=53.554), e esse e EXATAMENTE (ate a 3a casa decimal) o ponto inicial do segmento osmId=785117599 ('Rua Doutor Mario Vianna') - mesmo no OSM, cruzamento real, nao aproximacao. Torre movida de novo: as 9 celulas 'L' do footprint ANTERIOR (rows 47-49 x cols 30-32, adicionado na correcao acima) foram revertidas para '#' (mesmo raciocinio de sempre - bate com a vizinhanca imediata, que ja era '#' nessas mesmas linhas/colunas antes da 1a correcao), e as 9 celulas do footprint NOVO (rows 50-52 x cols 36-38) foram marcadas 'L'. Footprint novo escolhido por ficar 100% dentro de celulas '#' reais E encostar (4-adjacencia) em rua andavel '.' em DUAS bordas ao mesmo tempo - leste inteiro (col39, rows50-52, que e o proprio corredor vertical que desce ate o no do cruzamento em row53/54) e sul inteiro (row53, cols36-38, a rua horizontal que cruza ali) - um lote de esquina de verdade, colado no cruzamento sem ficar sentado em cima do no da rua (que fica sobre asfalto, celula '.', nao seria valido pra footprint). Ver data/overworld/pois.json:_position_note para o raciocinio completo do lado do POI (globalCol/globalRow/defaultSpawn novos).
